name: HKA Canonical End-to-End Pipeline

stages.exit_gate: canonical HKA World Tree source fixed by exact commit
all six canonical branches complete plus global coverage, prerequisite and semantic duplicate audits PASS
global academic lock commit exists; later stages reference it immutably
complete lesson records and website-target metadata authored from academic lock
global lesson prerequisite, coverage, age/path and duplicate audits PASS

all required visual descriptions and exact prompts authored only from locked lesson records; every production-bound asset includes locked character references when required plus deterministic logo/motto policies and brand-safe placement
global semantic/visual duplicate audit, prompt integrity audit and mandatory brand-field audit PASS

stages.system: HKA_AUTOPILOT plus Generation AI plus deterministic brand compositor
stages.exit_gate: CLEAN_MASTER generated with stable Asset ID/provenance and BRANDED_FINAL deterministically composed using official locked logo and exact motto
CLEAN_MASTER and BRANDED_FINAL stored create-only with separate checksums, brand provenance and read-back verification
exact staging binaries receive QA_APPROVED only after academic, visual, technical and brand-integrity checks; BRAND_GATE_FAILED cannot progress
only QA_APPROVED exact binaries promoted and canonical release verified
web derivatives generated only from verified vault masters; official branding is preserved without generative reconstruction and quality checks PASS
approved optimized derivatives plus release metadata available to website
LESSON_ID mapping places delivery asset into correct program, age/path, lesson and website slot

recovery_rule: Every stage records durable checkpoint, accepted commit/object hashes, status and next_action. Any replacement window or worker reads those records and resumes; it never depends on chat history.
brand_failure_rule: Missing or malformed logo/motto is a deterministic BRAND_GATE_FAILED defect. Fix branding and re-verify; do not spend a new full Generation AI render unless the educational CLEAN_MASTER itself is defective.
